purpose: Research-only evidence packet for five individually registered Dublin City NIAH buildings selected from the latest official missing-registration queue.

official_dataset_reference.title: NIAH Data Download
official_dataset_reference.note: Official national CSV ITM coordinates are EPSG:2157; CSV latitude/longitude are separate fields. Individual-page coordinate pairs are stored separately because their CRS is not labelled in the page display.

candidate_records.description_summary: Attached square-plan single-bay single-storey gate lodge, built c.1838; flat roof behind granite parapet, granite walls and quoins, moulded cornice and Doric columns. Adjoining gateway with granite piers and cast-iron gate.
candidate_records.appraisal_summary: Part of a pair flanking the railings before the former National Model Schools campus; probably designed by Jacob Owen in the 1830s. Granite detailing and railings attributed to Richard Turner.
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010220 present in workflow #1983 Dublin City missing-registration queue.

candidate_records.page_title: National Model Schools originally Tyrone House
candidate_records.description_summary: Attached five-bay three-storey mansion over exposed basement, built 1740, with granite portico and later granite-fronted addition. NIAH record attributes original design to Richard Castle for Marcus Beresford and remodelling to Jacob Owen c.1835; interior retains a stair hall, mahogany stair and decorative plasterwork.
candidate_records.appraisal_summary: NIAH identifies the building as Tyrone House, an important Georgian house later incorporated into the National Model Schools campus; it describes the portico, stair hall and stucco work as significant.
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010221 present in workflow #1983 Dublin City missing-registration queue.

candidate_records.description_summary: Detached four-bay three-storey school over raised basement, built 1902, with seven-bay return, projecting end bays, shallow breakfront, hipped slate roof, rendered walls and granite doorcase; timber sliding sash windows and interior staircase/joinery features recorded.
candidate_records.appraisal_summary: NIAH states it housed the laboratory block and lecture hall of the National Model Schools complex; symmetry, granite doorcase and retained interior features contribute to its interest.
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010223 present in workflow #1983 Dublin City missing-registration queue.

candidate_records.description_summary: Freestanding model school built 1838, three-bay single-storey block over half-basement, projecting end bays and central portico with Tuscan columns, central clock stage and copper dome; timber sash windows and rendered detailing.
candidate_records.appraisal_summary: Designed by Jacob Owen for 300 students annually; NIAH notes retention of original form and fabric, symmetry and central clock stage.
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010224 present in workflow #1983 Dublin City missing-registration queue.

candidate_records.name: Central Model School
candidate_records.description_summary: Detached model school dated 1859, central two-storey block flanked by single-storey ranges and canted rear pavilions. Limestone rubble walls, red-brick quoins and detailing, sandstone courses, slate roofs and timber sash windows; restored 1995–1999 after a 1981 fire.
candidate_records.appraisal_summary: Designed by Frederick Darley in 1859 as part of the National Model Schools campus; NIAH notes architectural interest and social importance as a school connected to teacher training.
candidate_records.queue_membership: Exact REG_NO 50010225 present in workflow #1983 Dublin City missing-registration queue.

duplicate_screen.method: Exact registration-number lookup in latest workflow reconciliation plus exact-number searches of repository issues and all PR states.
duplicate_screen.result: No archive-register matches and no issue or pull-request matches were returned for these five exact registration numbers at time of research.

identity_and_spatial_cautions: The five registration numbers identify five separate NIAH entries; do not collapse them into one campus record.
50010220 is a gate lodge and 50010227 is its separately registered counterpart; the two gate lodges remain separate structures.

50010221 is identified by the individual NIAH page title as National Model Schools originally Tyrone House, while the national CSV NAME field is blank. Preserve the blank CSV NAME field and the page title separately; do not silently overwrite one with the other.
50010223, 50010224 and 50010225 are separate school buildings within the wider former National Model Schools campus.
NIAH use, condition and historical descriptions are survey-time source statements and do not establish present-day occupancy, access or condition.
Store raw individual-page coordinate pairs separately from official CSV ITM and latitude/longitude. Do not assume the page coordinate CRS.
explicitly_not_done: No source registry or visual inventory imports
No map pins or coordinate imports
